sources.no_go: the pinned world SQL v0.9.296: the exit portal's cell (a portal whose Destination is outside 0x5A48): 0x5A480124 (wcid 22662 to 0xF07F0039); no other cell is held back by hand. The ten traps are not no_go but avoid_regions (below), so the tour keeps their cells' slots (the traps' six boxes, avoid_regions: the ten Magic traps (weenie 7561, spell 1877 Nullify All Magic Other) placed in landblock 0x5A48, six boxes round them (each box's own source says the rows); GroundDraft does not draft them). M6 14 guard task (closes m6-barracks-trap-radius; BarracksLayoutTests): weenie 7561 is WeenieType 26, a Switch (ACE.Entity/Enum/WeenieType.cs @95ef426d), ItemUseable 1 (No), ActivationResponse 0x1000 (CastSpell), and no landblock_instance_link row names any of the ten; on ACE a player's contact reaches only a Portal, a PressurePlate, a Hotspot or a projectile (Player.OnCollideObject, WorldObjects/Player.cs:368-385), and a Switch casts its spell only from OnActivate through ActOnUse (WorldObjects/Switch.cs), which only a link or a Use reaches: so on this server the traps never fire. Were one to fire, its spell row 1877 (min_Power 0, max_Power 999, align 0, number 99, number_Variance 0; EnchantmentManager.SelectDispel, WorldObjects/Managers/EnchantmentManager.cs:526-601) takes every enchantment of either sign up to power 999, the buff bot's level VII lines (power 300 and more) included: 'level 6 or lower' is only the dats' description text, so the study's 'the bot's VII lines survive' does not hold. The trap's Setup 0x020000ED is 0.104 m in radius; each box keeps its trap and her body's radius with room to spare, and is a cost to the planner, not a wall: no leg of the tour comes within a trap's reach (the goals of 0x5A4801C2 and 0x5A4801E2, whose floor centres are traps, are moved out of their boxes, FightWalk's goal out of an avoid region)

Stats from the GroundDraft run of M6 3 a1 over the same dump (each from the weenie's rows): max_health is ACE's CreatureVital.MaxValue (CreatureVital.cs:104-131 @95ef426d), weenie_properties_attribute_2nd type 1 init_Level + level_From_C_P + Endurance / 2 rounded half up (AttributeFormula.cs:55-71); magic_defence is ACE's CreatureSkill.Current (CreatureSkill.cs:154-163), weenie_properties_skill type 15 init_Level + level_From_P_P + (Focus + Self) / 7 for a trained skill, which is why it is above the bare skill row of the local model's sheets and of item 0's sel-creatures.tsv; attributes are weenie_properties_attribute types 1 to 6 init_Level + level_From_C_P; damage_types the OR of the body parts' d_Type; swing_s not drafted (TODO(f11-swing-seconds)) M6 16 Q12: the facts a target's from_bestiary names (any of max_health, magic_defence, xp, resist_health_drain) are read from the bestiary's tables (the same pinned world SQL rows) at load; the numbers each ground reads are unchanged (GroundCreatureNumbersTests).

Oolutanga's Refuge's Mage 22721 and Healer 22725 are the island's shop: TODO(m6-island-vendors), item 4's, never added as vendors here (D48) Shopkeeper Renald the Elder 718 also sells the Leather Gauntlets 56 (Value 1,100, 1,485 pyreals; armour level 130, burden 270, ValidLocations 0x20, ClothingPriority 0x8000, no wield requirement; his create list holds it in the pinned SQL): the gear floor's hand armour (M6 7 AH: a corpse run's replace step buys it when no worn piece covers the hands). M6 8 D (m5-side-packs-use, m5-pack-short): the Pack row of Shopkeeper Renald the Elder: SELECT weenie_Class_Id FROM weenie_properties_create_list WHERE object_Id = 718 AND destination_Type = 4 AND weenie_Class_Id = 136 (one row, the world SQL v0.9.296); weenie 136 is a Container (ItemType 0x200, ItemsCapacity 24, PropertyInt 19 'Value' 65); price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x 65 - 0.1)) = 88. M6 14 (m6-purse; live 2026-11-12: a level 39 mage's main pack stood full of rings, bracelets, necklaces and gems, the sale named each one outside every listed mask and the loot rule then left every corpse for want of a free slot): Monyra the Jeweler 716 is the outskirts profile's fifth Holtburg row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4020, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B40117, Archmage Cindrue's entry hall, point (157.19, 135.298, 66.12), buys_item_types 0x00040808 = Jewelry 0x8 + Gem 0x800 + PromissoryNote 0x40000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 716 (one row: 2056994848, A9B40117, 157.19, 135.298, 66.12, 264200, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-12). Her MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and her MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Novedion the Gem Seller 9423 (outdoors at (124.79, 31.52, 94.01), mask 0x808, MerchandiseMaxValue 25,000) is not listed: Monyra's walk is the one the dat tests confirm (VendorStopConfirmDatTests and ResupplyRouteDatTests walk every vendor of the den's profile, hers among them) and the outskirts, the Burrow and the Lodge list her already. M6 14 grocer (the owner, 2026-11-13: sell the empty flasks; live 2026-11-13 04:54 UTC: the supply trip named every Empty Flask outside Monyra the Jeweler's mask and kept it): Fispur Ansel the Grocer 714 (holtburggrocer) is the outskirts profile's row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4024, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B4016A, his shop, point (78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005), buys_item_types 0x00446220 = Food 0x20 + Container 0x200 + Writable 0x2000 + Key 0x4000 + PromissoryNote 0x40000 + CraftCookingBase 0x400000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 714 (one row: 2056994852, A9B4016A, 78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005, 4481568, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-13). The Empty Flask (wcid 7940 flasksimple, ItemType 0x400000 CraftCookingBase, Value 1, MaxStackSize 1, so each one takes a slot; one is left by each potion she drinks, about 13 an hour) is in no other listed vendor's mask; ACE pays max(1, floor(0.9 x 1 + 0.1)) = 1 pyreal a flask (Vendor.cs GetBuyCost 591-599 @95ef426d). His MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and his MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Every other type of his mask is also Shopkeeper Renald the Elder's (0x480467A7), so he is listed after Renald: a tie of the loot buyers' counts goes to the profile's earlier row (ResupplyPlanner.LootBuyers), and that stays Renald. Her drinks (the Mana Potion 379, the Potion of Healing 377, the Health and Mana Tinctures 27319 and 27322) are Misc 0x80, outside his mask, and the sale keeps every drink she uses whatever a mask takes (ResupplyRun.DrinkInUse, m6-sale-keeps-drinks); a pack (Container) and a trade note are never offered (ResupplyRun.SaleItems). His stop is his own cell as Thelnoth's, Ecutha's and Monyra's are (the station's request stops ShopLeg.UnseenVendorReachMetres short of his point): the dat tests walk every vendor of the den's profile from Holtburg's lifestone, his leg among them (ResupplyRouteDatTests: the room graph's path, about 32 m, enters his shop through the room 0xA9B4016E and ends in 0xA9B4016A; VendorStopConfirmDatTests: the walker's pre-check confirms it and his point stands on the floor through the statics, and The_stations_walk_from_the_lifestone_to_the_Grocer_enters_his_shop_and_passes_the_pre_check plans the station's own request, his point with that range); the shop's two doors (0x7A9B401E and 0x7A9B401F, world objects the dats do not hold) and his body are not in those tests, and the walk to him has not been run live (TODO(m6-grocer-stop-point)).

The crossing levels are SpellPlan.LevelAt (Mage/SpellPlan.cs) over SpellPlan.ProjectedWarBase at plan_cast_chance 0.95, read for the rung's levels (the skill a level needs is its power + 43: III 143, IV 193, V 243, VI 293) (level 60 base 283 is V, 66 base 292 is V, 67 base 293 is VI, 74 base 302 is VI)). sources.components: M6 14 guard task (the owner, 2026-11-13: a ground profile holds facts only): the general default, tusker-abode.json's components (levels IV to VI) verbatim: the island's standard lines of the rung she climbs from while the Tusker Guard Kill Task (tusker-guard-kill-task.json) sends her here, levels 40 to 59 (war-mage.json: the Barracks is an alternate of the Quarters, levels 60 to 74, entered from 40 by its portal 22661); nothing here is sized for this ground or for a character; the foci formula of Flame Bolt IV to VI: M6 3 F1: Flame Bolt IV (level 41) is 1 Silver Scarab and 3 Prismatic Taper, the Temple 20-40's line (Silver Scarab 688 joins the stock and Cindrue's wares at 338, as there); the foci formula, as the Temple 20-40's (GearKit.FociFormulaCounts over the dats' Flame Bolt formulas; HuntingGroundDatTests.A_dungeons_components_cover_the_war_lines_formula_at_every_spell_level_its_plan_names pins the foci formula): Flame Bolt V (spell 84): 1 Gold Scarab and 4 Prismatic Taper. M6 3 F3 (3-R10, closes TODO(m6-dungeon-account-formula)): the account formula of 'test' (SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount, read from the dats; what Winnie casts if she loses her Foci of Strife, HasFoci, Player_Spells.cs 458-488 @95ef426d) is carried beside the foci formula, as the outskirts carry it (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.components), for each spell level of the plan, pinned by HuntingGroundDatTests.A_climbers_dungeon_carries_the_account_test_formula_beside_the_foci_formula: IV (spell level 4): Silver Scarab, Pink Taper, Hawthorn, Blue Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman; V (spell level 5): Gold Scarab, Orange Taper, Hawthorn, Indigo Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Red Taper, Birch Talisman. Every coloured taper, herb, powder and talisman is a row of Archmage Cindrue's create list (weenie 2304, weenie_properties_create_list, destination 4, the pinned world SQL v0.9.296; Value 25 tapers, 10 Hawthorn, 5 the powder, Turpeth and Talisman; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 34, 14, 7); the scarabs are the foci formula's lines above. Carried, no Holtburg vendor sells them (not in 2304's create list): Gold Scarab, TODO(m6-island-vendors). M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): level VI's formulas, the Quarters' rows (tusker-quarters.json components): the foci formula, Flame Bolt VI (spell 85): 1 Pyreal Scarab and 4 Prismatic Taper; the account formula VI: Pyreal Scarab, Yellow Taper, Hawthorn, Violet Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Indigo Taper, Birch Talisman. No plan row names VI (the base skill reaches 293 only at 67); the level up job's fight casts it by the live cap (FightOptions.LiveCap) when her buffed War Magic lands it at 0.95, and the fight's own check skips it while the pack lacks a component. The Pyreal Scarab is the town stock's (Uziz); the Yellow Taper 1653 and the Violet Taper 1651 are Archmage Cindrue's (create list rows, Value 25, 34 pyreals) and stock lines.
sources.supplies: M6 14 guard task (the owner, 2026-11-13: a ground profile holds facts only): the general default, tusker-abode.json's supplies (stock, kit, burden line and purse) verbatim: the island's standard lines of the rung she climbs from while the Tusker Guard Kill Task (tusker-guard-kill-task.json) sends her here, levels 40 to 59 (war-mage.json: the Barracks is an alternate of the Quarters, levels 60 to 74, entered from 40 by its portal 22661); nothing here is sized for this ground or for a character; TODO(m6-derived-supplies) (docs/milestones/m6-derived-rules.md): the keep, trip and stop lines, the purse and the town stock from her measured burn an hour x the hours to the next trip and the vendors' prices, not from a profile. The Abode's own sizing, for the record: M6 3 p2, sized from the rung 'abode' as the outskirts profile was (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): the modelled rate is twice the move-on floor, 172 kills an hour, at the move-on ceiling of 7.3 casts a kill (ladder/war-mage.json) = 1256 casts an hour, all of them Flame Bolt V as the worst case, 4 Prismatic Tapers a cast on the foci formula = 5024 tapers an hour. Prismatic Taper 20631 (Archmage Cindrue, 30): keep 850 = 10 minutes of that burn (837) rounded up to 50 (capped at 1,000, a stack's limit; 6 burden each, and the capacity is the climber's Strength, TODO(m6-climber-strength)), trip_under 300 (a third of the keep rounded up to 50), stop_under 5 (a cast needs 4). Scarabs: Gold Scarab 687 (the only spell level here) is CARRIED: no Holtburg vendor sells it (Cindrue's wares in the draft's town half end at the Silver Scarab), so the line has no vendor, keep 20, trip_under = stop_under = 2 as the Black Spawn Den's carried lines (D8): a stack under 2 stops the loop by name; where the climber buys it is TODO(m6-island-vendors), item 4's; no spell here burns more than ComponentLoss 0.05 x CDM 0.1 = 0.005 a cast (Flame Bolt II's 0.05, Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d; III to VII unmeasured, TODO(m6-component-loss-iii-v)), so 20 scarabs last 3.2 hours at 1256 casts an hour. The Copper Scarab 686 is on every spine profile at keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2 (the Temple 40+'s line): the four travel spells (Lifestone Recall and Tie, Primary Portal Tie and Recall) burn one a cast on the foci formula, and GearKit.CastBurns refuses a ground that cannot buy it (GrantsCountedTests). Mana Potion 379 (Thelnoth, 230): keep 5, trip_under 2, stop_under 0, the outskirts' reserve. One restock from nothing at these keeps is 29,350 pyreals at the vendors' prices (850 Prismatic Tapers at 30 = 25,500; 20 Copper Scarabs at 135 = 2,700; 5 Mana Potions at 230 = 1,150); purse: coin 30,000 (that rounded up to 1,000, the floor the coin is kept at as the outskirts' is), notes of min_note 10,000 and up (the surplus is kept as bonded notes: a death takes half the coin and no note, Player_Death.cs:347-360 @95ef426d), the one note listed is the outskirts' placeholder count 1 (TODO(m6-purse-note-count)). kit: none, as the outskirts' and the Temple 20-40's (a kit line would put the ground into the level-80 buff-kit checks of GrantsCountedTests and MageBuildScenarioTests); the floor's Wand and Faran Robe with Hood stay sold by Cindrue and Ecutha for GearFloor; burden_trip_percent 150 as the outskirts'. M6 3 F3: the account formula's lines (herbs, powders, talismans, coloured tapers) are stock lines at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the outskirts' rule for them (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): a backup the focus-holding climber does not burn, a rung's cost of about 250 pyreals the first restock, inside the purse (see components) M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Gold Scarab 687 is no carried stock line any more: it is the town stock's, bought at Uziz on the way out with the Pyreal Scarab 690 (the town_stock section gives the seller, the price and the sizing); nothing of it stops the run. M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): the Cave's drinks and scarabs: Potion of Healing 377 (Thelnoth Cort the Healer; BoostValue 25 on Health, Value 170, 230 pyreals): keep 30, trip_under 6, stop_under 0, listed before the Mana Potion so a short trip budget fills it first, the Cave's sizing (tusker-cave.json sources.supplies: a drink of 2.5 s is 10 health a second, a way out of 20 to 30 s is 8 to 12 drinks); the Mana Potion 379 keeps 100, trip_under 10 (it was 5 and 2), the Cave's: the fallback to the Mana Tincture of the town stock, 2,500 mana; the Silver Scarab 688 keeps 20, trip_under 5 (it was 10 and 3, a lower level's line), the Cave's cap-level line: besides Flame Bolt IV at 40 and 41 it is burned by the level IV item spells her pass keeps on her armour, Impenetrability, Bludgeon Bane and the six other banes (war-mage.json sources.vitals, m6-banes: about 25 s and eight casts a pass); the level VI account formula's Yellow Taper 1653 and Violet Taper 1651 at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the account lines' rule. The Health Tincture 27319 and the Mana Tincture 27322 are the town stock's (Ludora the Healer, Dryreach), the Cave's rows. One restock from nothing at these keeps is 65,406 pyreals (850 Prismatic Tapers 25,500; 20 Silver Scarabs at 338, 6,760; 20 Copper Scarabs 2,700; 30 Potions of Healing 6,900; 100 Mana Potions 23,000; the eleven account lines 546), so the coin is 66,000 (that rounded up to 1,000; it was 30,000), the note as before.

approach.source: M6 14 entry recharge (the owner, 2026-11-13: a ground profile holds facts only; never a fight number): the outdoor approach to the entry, the landblock of the Facility Hub portal's drop 0xF07E0040 (travel-routes.json, edge hub-barracks) and the landblock of the entry front 0xF07F0039 (this profile's entry), and the hostiles the world spawns there. The pinned world SQL v0.9.296 (an offline read of the dump, 2026-11-13), table encounter: landblock 0xF07E holds six rows of the Tusker Island High Beach Mix Gen (weenie 22533), cells (0,6) (1,7) (2,5) (5,3) (6,4) (6,7); landblock 0xF07F holds eight rows of the Tusker Island High Mix Gen (22386), cells (3,2) (4,3) (6,1) (6,3) (6,5) (7,1) (7,2) (7,4), two of 22533, (0,1) and (4,0), and five of the Tusker Island Mid Mountain Mix Gen (22538), (1,6) (1,7) (3,5) (4,5) (4,6). ACE puts an encounter's generator at (cell_X x 24, cell_Y x 24) of its landblock (Landblock.cs:282-283 @95ef426d): the nearest to the drop (171.6, 188.8) is the 22533 at (144, 168) of 0xF07E, and the nearest to the front (176.9, 12.7) the 22386 at (168, 24) of 0xF07F. weenie_properties_generator: 22386 and 22533 each roll the Silver Tusker 7184 and the Armored Tusker 11540 alone, the Tusker Island SA Camp Gen 22409 (Silver Tuskers and Armored Tuskers) and the SA Mix Camp Gen 22410 (Silver Tuskers, Armored Tuskers and a Tusker Worshipper), the Tusker Guard 1629 alone, the SG Camp Gen 22412 (Tusker Guards and Tusker Slaves) and the SG Mix Camp Gen 22413 (Tusker Guards, Tusker Slaves and a Tusker Worshipper); the names are weenie_properties_string type 1. Their other outcomes (the Tusker Slave, the Stinging Chittick, the Reedshark Ravager, the Tusker Worshipper, the White Phyntos Wasp, the Tuskie Launcher and Thrower, the Tusker Liberator) and the 22538's are not listed: one hostile is enough to call a drop here hostile. Seen live on 2026-11-13 (cache/m6/14/live/ladder1, 19:34:36 to 19:36:11 UTC): three Silver Tuskers, an Armored Tusker and two Tusker Guards attacked the climber between the drop and the front (the fight-back killed five of them, the sixth hit her at the front). No landblock_instance row of 0xF07E or 0xF07F places a creature or a generator (only the Tusker Barracks portal, guid 0x7F07F000). M6 14 drain resistance: resist_health_drain is the weenie's ResistHealthDrain, weenie_properties_float type 125 (ACE's GetResistanceMod(HealthDrain), Creature_Properties.cs:207-208 @95ef426d, times a natural resistance of 1 and no life-resist rating, int 351, which none of these weenies has), the share of a Drain Health Other's take ACE lets through before the cap (WorldObject_Magic.cs:719-721) and of a Harm Other's roll (:491); written only where it is not 1 (the loader's default, ACE's), read through Vitals.DrainResist; the world copy read-only, 2026-11-14: the Armored Tusker 11540 0 (row 321267); the Silver Tusker 7184 and the Tusker Guard 1629 are 1 (rows 321145 and 321115). M6 16 Q12: the facts a hostile's from_bestiary names (any of health, magic_defence, resist, awareness_m, xp, pace, resist_health_drain) are read from the bestiary's tables (the same pinned world SQL rows) at load; the numbers each ground reads are unchanged (GroundCreatureNumbersTests).

town_stock.name: Health Tincture
town_stock.source: M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): the Health Tincture 27319 of Ludora the Healer 2229 of Dryreach, 775 pyreals, the Cave's line of the same ware (tusker-cave.json town_stock: the seller, her create list and SellPrice 1.55, the SELECTs on the world copy, and the stop on the way out from the Town Network, network-to-dryreach and dryreach-to-network, travel-routes.json). keep 12 and trip_under 6 are the Cave's sizing: a tincture a drink of 2.5 s is 20 health a second, the one drink that out-heals a pack (the Cave's 8 to 11.6 health a second, which the Redeemer's hit 82 over the Crimsonback's 65 makes 10.1 to 14.6 here); a stand of 20 to 30 s takes about 6. The Abode's own rate is not measured (TODO(m6-abode-fight-live)); the walk from the drop to her is not walked live yet (TODO(m6-town-stock-live)).

town_stock.name: Mana Tincture
town_stock.source: M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): the Mana Tincture 27322 at the same counter, 775 pyreals, the Cave's line of the same ware (tusker-cave.json town_stock). keep 30 and trip_under 10 are the Cave's sizing: the Cave drank about 4,000 mana an hour on 2026-11-11; 30 tinctures are 1,500 mana and the 100 Mana Potions of the home walk 2,500, a stretch between trips and two thirds of the next. A kill here costs 74 mana before Mana Conversion (the fight section) against the Cave's 33 (tusker-cave.json fight), and the modelled 172 kills an hour against the Cave's 224 (twice the move-on floors, war-mage.json) make about 12,700 mana an hour before Mana Conversion against the Cave's 7,400, so the Abode's drink is likely higher than the Cave's: not measured (TODO(m6-abode-fight-live)). The burden: 30 x 50 + 100 x 15 + 12 x 50 + 30 x 15 = 4,050 for the four drinks, as the Cave's.

town_stock.name: Gold Scarab
town_stock.source: M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Gold Scarab 687 of level V at Archmage Sammam al-Ashiz 1824 of Uziz, 775 pyreals: the seller, the read-only SELECTs, the walk from the Network drop and back (TownNetworkWalkDatTests) and the sizing (0.02 a cast at the worst case, 25.1 an hour at about 1,250 casts; keep 100 is 4 hours, a stop at most every 2 h 23 min) are tusker-cave.json's town_stock line of the same ware. It replaces the carried stock line of this profile (keep 20, trip_under = stop_under = 2): a carried line under its stop line stops the run by name (LogisticsCounters, the stock stop), no catalog seller lists the Gold Scarab (BuyTripRule: no-seller, TODO(m6-buy-trip-seller)), and the ladder's character, never granted anything, would have stopped at this rung's door as she did at the Temple 20-40 on 2026-11-12. The spell plan's level V row stays: the profile loader, GearKit.CastBurns and FightScenario.WarKitCarries take a town stock line for a plan component (HuntingGround.TownStockOf); a pack with none casts level IV on the Silver Scarab line.

town_stock.name: Pyreal Scarab
town_stock.source: M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Pyreal Scarab 690 of level VI at the same counter, 1,550 pyreals: sourced and sized in tusker-cave.json's town_stock line of the same ware (0.03 a cast at the worst case; keep 100 is 2 h 40 min, a stop at most every 96 minutes); not bought before the book holds a level VI spell. No plan row of this profile casts level VI; the line serves the heals, the drains and the buffs her skill reaches. M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): the level up job's fight casts Flame Bolt VI here when her live War Magic lands it at 0.95 (the ladder's live cap, FightOptions.LiveCap; the buff bot's War Magic of about 297 to 301 at level 40 does), so the line serves the bolt too, and the components list level VI's formulas.

fight.source: M6 14 guard task (the owner, 2026-11-13: no hand-sized fight block): only the owner's general rules, one each and the same on every ground (M6 7 AN, M6 8: the full bar 100, the health line 70, the rest until 100 lying down, a potion before a rest for mana, the mana line 75 and the stamina floor 15 while potions are in use; docs/milestones/m6-derived-rules.md lists them as one general constant each), and one fact of the place: pull_aggro_metres 25, the VisualAwarenessRange (PropertyFloat 31) of the Tusker Guards 1629 and 22593 (SELECT object_Id, type, value FROM weenie_properties_float WHERE object_Id IN (1629, 22593) AND type = 31, read only, 2026-11-13). No retreat_health_percent and no pull_mana_percent: the retreat falls to the autopilot's general floor and the pull's mana is the vitals policy's live line on her pool; TODO(m6-derived-fight-wiring) (docs/milestones/m6-derived-rules.md): the retreat line from her live health, her damage factor and the Guards' hits and pack (FightLines.RetreatPercent, built, not yet wired)

avoid_regions.name: the three traps in 0x5A480156
avoid_regions.source: the pinned world SQL v0.9.296 (landblock_instance rows of landblock 0x5A48, wcid 7561): 0x75A48011, 0x75A48012, 0x75A48013 at (52.824, -123.252), (49.7554, -123.252), (46.7372, -123.252), z -5.995 (landblock-local, in cell 0x5A480156). Weenie 7561 'trap-dispellall' (PropertyString 1 'Magic trap') carries PropertyDataId 28 (Spell) 1877, which the dats name Nullify All Magic Other ('Dispels all enchantments of level 6 or lower from the target', the dats' text; the server's row takes every line). The box is the point(s) with 1 m of margin each side in x and y (M6 14 guard task: the trap's Setup 0x020000ED is 0.104 m in radius, her body 0.48 m, and 0.4 m to spare; the earlier 2 m was a guess while the radius was unread) and 2 m in z (a costly box the walk's planner goes round while another way exists, RoomPatches.SeededCostMetres as the den's pocket, M5 7 P7i D144); the trap is an unlinked Switch that fires on nothing on ACE @95ef426d, and its row 1877 would take every line, the bot's level VII included (sources.no_go; BarracksLayoutTests). Confirms the local model's check (cache/local-model/compare/check/RESULT.md): 10 traps, here 3 + 1 + 3 + 1 + 1 + 1 over six cells
